design: Signed linear encoder with block-L2 TopK, linear decoder with unit column norms. Train mean/global RMS scaling only. Same seeded minibatches across block widths. Validation checkpoint selection; test untouched. Fixed-compute pilot, not convergence claim.
limitations: Rank1 is signed absolute-TopK sparse dictionary baseline, not ReLU SAE. Fixed scalar budget changes active-block count; no single fairness criterion. No dead-block resampling or auxiliary loss. Finite training may favor easier optimizers.
